pokedexEntries.bk: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

pokedexEntries.wh: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

pokedexEntries.sw: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that’s said to have been the face it had when it was still human.

pokedexEntries.sh: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

pokedexEntries.za: Each Yamask carries a mask representing the face it had when it was still human. Sometimes it gazes at the mask and weeps.
